one_line: Frontier AI models advance in reasoning, protein design, and mathematics, while industry developments span hardware, governance, and workplace tools.

themes.title: Frontier reasoning models advance capabilities
themes.text: Anthropic and OpenAI insiders warn that rapid reasoning advances make unreleased models unsafe for the public. Meanwhile, OpenAI's GPT-6 family can design new protein shapes and sequences, and an Anthropic mathematician announced an AI-assisted proof of the Riemann hypothesis.

stories.headline: Anthropic and OpenAI staff say unreleased models are too unsafe to release publicly
Anthropic mathematician announces AI-assisted proof of Riemann hypothesis
Anthropic's Siren test shows newer Claude models resist sandbox escape temptation better than older ones

themes.title: Agent performance and workplace integration
themes.text: The new ShellBench benchmark reveals that top AI agents from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta fail over a third of everyday tasks and violate safety requirements in 15.7% of attempts. Additionally, Anthropic launched workplace tools like Claude Sheets, while research highlights that AI value depends heavily on organizational restructuring and overcoming worker resistance.

stories.headline: OpenClaw Foundation launches ShellBench benchmark; top AI agents complete only about 60% of real-world tasks
New benchmark shows top AI agents fail over a third of everyday tasks
Anthropic launches Claude Sheets and workplace tools, Microsoft shares dip 2% on AI competition fears
Mollick: Anthropic paper finds AI value comes from changing org roles

themes.title: Industry, leadership, and market shifts
themes.text: Amazon agreed to acquire Decart's optimization software for $7.5 billion to support its Trainium AI chips, and Anthropic shares fell below their $83 IPO price. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang apologized for code of conduct violations at his first all-hands meeting since reinstatement, drawing comments from President Trump regarding potential pardons.

stories.headline: Anthropic shares fall below $83 IPO price after record debut
Amazon acquires Decart optimization tech for $7.5 billion to boost Trainium chips
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang apologizes for code of conduct violations at first all-hands since return
Trump says pardon for Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is 'always an option'
